items.title: 26.4 Monomers se polymerisation ki qism ka andaza (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 26.4.1 shuru karti hai. Is hisse mein hum monomer ki banawat dekh kar andaza lagayenge ke polymerisation kis qism ki hogi: 26.4.1 mein C=C wale monomers (addition), aur 26.4.2 mein do functional groups wale monomers (condensation).

blocks.prompt: Propene aur 6-aminohexanoic acid kis qism ki polymerisation karenge?
blocks.explanation: Propene mein C=C hai: addition. 6-aminohexanoic acid mein -NH₂ aur -COOH dono hain: condensation, polyamide banta hai.

items: C=C wala monomer: addition; do reactive functional groups: condensation.
